notes.title: A couple more tweaks
notes.content:
Hey folks! Another small update, mainly focused on fixes.

- Pressing and holding left/right on the level select screen scrolls through the levels now
- Slightly reduced the time it takes to load the level select screen
- Fixed the level select screen not loading at all on some Steam Decks
- Hopefully fixed the rare crash that would happen when exiting the game from the main menu
- Fixed end screens not adjusting to gamepad input properly
- Fixed a minor visual bug on the steam deck in the menus

You may also notice a new grayed out option to the settings menu - you can't use it yet, but it will be important soon!

Hey folks! Three Bulky Bears' lead dev here. Thanks so much to everyone who's been playing so far and for your positive comments! We've just pushed a small update that fixes a handful of minor bugs and issues. 

The main takeaways are:
- Minor tweaks on a couple of levels, namely The Windy Way and Mad Dash Oasis, to reduce frustration
- Some minor adjustments to existing tutorial text and a couple new lines for improved clarity
- A bit of polish for a smoother experience on the main menu
- The settings menu should now be navigable via controller
- Tutorial should now start with the correct prompts if you've been using controller in the menu
- Clouds in the background no longer pop out of existence while on screen
- Papa Bear no longer has mesothelioma
- A handful of very slight optimizations

I'm also pushing a very small update in like two minutes (because I forgot to add it to this update, oops) that adds A/Space as a button to restart the level from the Game Over screen.

We have a handful of exciting plans for bigger additions and improvements in the works, but those will have to wait a little longer for further testing, and to give us a chance to decompress now that the game's out. 

If you notice any other bugs or major issues, let us know at threebulkybears@gmail.com or in our [url=https://discord.gg/TRwkVhHWc5]Discord server[/url]. And if you've been enjoying the game, please recommend it to your friends and consider leaving a positive review on Steam! It helps out a TON!
